messages.plaintextBody:
May 29, 2026

Mr. Ryan Labrador
Co-Founder and CEO
REVLV Solutions, Inc.

Dear Mr. Labrador,

Businesses face increasing demands in managing reputation and stakeholder engagement. Strengthening your team's expertise in communication and journalism can support more effective brand management, digital media engagement, and corporate communication initiatives that contribute to organizational success.

The Asian Institute of Journalism and Communication (AIJC) cordially invites your management team, HR professionals, and communication practitioners to our upcoming free Virtual Open House.

Virtual Open House
Link to the Virtual Open House will be provided upon registration. This event is free.
June 3, 2026 | via MS Teams | 10:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m

Why Attend?
This brief, one-hour session is designed to introduce your organization to our three graduate programs and answer any questions you may have. Discover how these programs can help enhance your workforce's capabilities:
- Master of Arts in Journalism
- Master of Arts in Communication
- Master in Communication Major in Public Relations and Corporate Communication

Whether you are looking to sponsor a key employee's professional development or seeking flexible, high-caliber graduate programs for your team, this Open House will provide the information you need regarding the curriculum, class schedule, and admissions process.

How to Register
Admission is free, but slots are limited. Register here to secure your slot.

Thank you very much for your time and continued dedication to professional excellence. We look forward to welcoming you and your team on June 3!

For registration assistance or inquiries, you may email gs@aijci.com or call +63 2 8743 4321.

Sincerely,
Janess Ann J. Ellao
Director of Student Affairs
Asian Institute of Journalism and Communication
2244 Espana Blvd., Sampaloc, Manila
+63287434321 | aijc.com.ph
